import json

def sanitize(title):
    # replace whitespace with underscore
    import re as _re
    return _re.sub(r'\s', '_', title)

rows = []
for nid in sorted(full_notes):
    n = full_notes[nid]
    content = n['content']
    sha = hl.sha256(content.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
    rows.append({
        "note_id": nid,
        "title": n['title'],
        "filename_md": sanitize(n['title']) + ".md",
        "content_len": len(content),
        "content_sha256": sha,
        "tags": n['tags'],
        "pinned": n['pinned'],
        "created_at": n['created_at'],
        "updated_at": n['updated_at'],
    })
